notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two doors of the upper cabinet are counted separately because they are independently hinged and opened sequentially. Their closures both occur between frames 552 and 560, so the individual off-frame ordering is approximate.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a wide food-storage drawer, separately opens and closes both doors of the cabinet above the range hood, and finally opens and closes a utensil drawer beside the stove.
